# DeciMatrix 1.0

`FDOS/` contains the original package from
[`clasqm/freedos-repo`](https://github.com/clasqm/freedos-repo/blob/master/zip/dcmatrix.zip).
It includes `dcmatrix.com`, the GPLv3 license, package metadata, and source.
The package metadata states an 8086 processor and 16 KiB RAM minimum.
